text.p: SAN CARLOS, Calif., Dec 2 (Reuter) Conceptus Inc said on Monday it has completed its acquisition of Microgyn Inc, a private medical device company, for cash and common stock.
Almost all the $4.0 million fixed portion of the purchase price is expected to be accounted for as in-process research and development and expensed in the fourth quarter of 1996.
Microgyn is focused on developing products to increase the safety and performance of resectoscope procedures, including therapeutic hysteroscopy.
"Microgyn's technology provides Conceptus another platform from which to broaden our product portfolio for the interventional gynecologist," commented Kathryn Tunstall, chief executive of Conceptus.
